body:
The explicit outside-file denial failed. This Draft preserves a separately frozen runtime candidate and its one deterministic preflight, following the prelaunch apparatus stop in #32.

The installed Codex CLI 0.154.0 started in the intended fixture root and read the allowlisted file exactly, then returned the exact denied outside sentinel with exit code 0 and empty stderr. The hard failure stopped the sequence after three subprocesses. Alternate paths, mutation and filename invariance remain NOT_RUN. No case author, adjudicator, semantic assessor, ledger reducer, project generation or initialization canary was invoked.

The candidate uses the CLI's explicit named sandbox profile with root/temp denial, minimal runtime reads and an exact outside-file deny. The loaded legacy sandbox setting is recorded as part of the candidate. The cause of the failed effective enforcement remains UNKNOWN; this does not establish an OS-wide sandbox defect.

## Frozen evidence

- Candidate commit: `511d016c9840ce77fc8be284d9c4f5202b910820`; tree: `b3a1f315da48e686b5475f35285b418f476a7d7b`.
- Terminal evidence commit: `c117e03b81cdd69cbfb8fa202b518fe87377606e`; tree: `1fde30f270d3ca0cc63a385e160b5e9f6e414b7e`.
- Terminal SHA-256: `ed31d83ef4f4ad38830914554943c0b7ef3a0f2c4cfc21469d9fed6244b06e03`.
- [Terminal record](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/blob/c117e03b81cdd69cbfb8fa202b518fe87377606e/research/evidence/sealed-role-runtime-preflight-v1/TERMINAL.json), [probe P2](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/blob/c117e03b81cdd69cbfb8fa202b518fe87377606e/research/evidence/sealed-role-runtime-preflight-v1/probes/P2.json), [methods and results](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/blob/c117e03b81cdd69cbfb8fa202b518fe87377606e/research/evidence/sealed-role-runtime-preflight-v1/RESULTS.md).

## Verification

Six construction checks, candidate-only Ruff and structural contract lint passed before the clean candidate freeze. After execution, all 15 frozen candidate artifacts, all 36 predecessor records, the installed binary, loaded base configuration and four fixture hashes remained unchanged. Raw streams and exact private bindings are hash-bound; local paths/operator metadata were sanitized before public evidence freeze. No post-freeze source/config repair or valid-probe retry occurred.

Hosted CI on the terminal evidence head failed Python lint with 298 inherited findings in each of three jobs; all affected Git blobs match the predecessor, and no new preflight source had a diagnostic. Tests/compile/corpus smoke were skipped. Static demo parity passed. [Hosted run](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/actions/runs/36937337023). These observations do not determine the runtime disposition. No frozen record was edited to change CI.

Append-only [publication/issue reconciliation](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/blob/5449900a28a8a3c07af0b3fd2da4c9aa5b36643e/research/evidence/sealed-role-runtime-preflight-v1/PUBLICATION.json) preserves both verified terminal comments, completed issue #33, retained resources and CI classification.

## Disposition and successor

`FALSIFIED` for this pinned runtime/configuration. Full model initialization and network enforcement remain unobserved. A separately frozen runtime candidate with auditable effective configuration is the next evidence-producing step; semantic roles stay stopped until it qualifies.

Tracks #33. Predecessor: #32. Semantic preparation in #30 and the failed semantic execution remain unchanged. Wave B remains LOCKED. No merge, promotion or release.
